rationale: Tests understanding of geriatric syndromes — the '5 I's' (Immobility, Instability, Incontinence, Intellectual impairment, Iatrogenic illness) covered in the Physical Health Problems block.
Tests recall of the Katz ADL Index as a standard geriatric functional assessment tool, covered in the Geriatric Syndromes and Functional Decline block.
Applies the Geriatric Depression Scale-15 (GDS-15) in a community medicine context, as discussed in the Mental and Psychosocial Health Problems block and the Community Perspective section.
Tests understanding of tertiary prevention and rehabilitation principles as applied to the elderly, covered in the Tertiary Prevention block.
Tests recall of NPHCE structure, components, and implementation as covered in the NPHCE blocks.
Applies knowledge of early identification screening tools (MMSE, GDS-15, TUG, Katz ADL, Lawton-Brody IADL) to a practical case scenario, as covered in the Early Identification of Health Needs block.
